title: Error recovery UI — typed error handling with auto-retry and error cards
description: Update frontend hooks (useChatStreaming, useChatRecovery) to handle the new typed error events from the backend. Map recoverable errors to auto-retry (max 2 attempts) and non-recoverable errors to user-visible error cards in ChatAreaStreamStatus with Retry and Dismiss actions.
action: In useChatStreaming.ts onError handler, parse payload.error_class and payload.recoverable. If recoverable and retryCount < 2, auto-retry after payload.retry_after seconds. If non-recoverable, emit structured error to useChatRecovery. In ChatAreaStreamStatus.tsx, add error card rendering for non-recoverable errors with Retry and Dismiss buttons.

criteria: src/hooks/useChatStreaming.ts contains 'retry_after' or 'retryAfter' or auto-retry logic
src/hooks/useChatRecovery.ts contains 'recoverable' or structured error type handling
src/components/ChatAreaStreamStatus.tsx contains 'Retry' button or retry action for error state
convergence.verification: Trigger a non-recoverable error event, verify error card appears with Retry and Dismiss buttons. Trigger a recoverable error, verify auto-retry fires without user interaction.
convergence.definition_of_done: Recoverable errors auto-retry up to 2 times. Non-recoverable errors show human-readable error card with retry/dismiss.

files.change: Parse payload.error_class and payload.recoverable from SSE error event. If recoverable and retryCount < 2, schedule auto-retry via setTimeout(payload.retry_after * 1000). Track retryCount in ref. On max retries exceeded or non-recoverable, emit structured error to recovery hook.
Accept structured error objects with {error_class, recoverable, message}. Add setStructuredError() to expose error details to ChatArea. Add retryFromError() that re-triggers send with original input.

When recoverStatus has error_class, render error card with: error message, error class label, Retry button (calls onRetryFromError), Dismiss button (calls onDismissStatus). Style with red/warning variant.

implementation: In useChatStreaming.ts: Add retryCountRef = useRef(0). In onError, check payload.error_class and payload.recoverable. If recoverable and retryCountRef.current < 2, increment count, schedule setTimeout(() => startStream(originalRequest), (payload.retry_after || 5) * 1000). Reset retryCountRef on successful stream completion.
In useChatRecovery.ts: Extend RecoverStatus type to include error_class and recoverable fields. Add retryFromError() function that re-calls handleSend with the last sent message.

In ChatAreaStreamStatus.tsx: When recoverStatus.type === 'error' and recoverStatus.error_class exists, render error card with: <div className='error-card'> with message, class label badge, Retry button calling onRetry, Dismiss button calling onDismiss

reference.pattern: useChatStreaming follows onError → finalize('error') pattern — add branching before finalize

rationale.chosen_approach: Auto-retry in the streaming hook keeps the recovery transparent to the user for transient errors, while surfacing persistent errors via the existing ChatAreaStreamStatus component
